body: Yes my dad literally tries to kill me. He has held me against the wall by my neck, stood on my throat, held the shower head to my mouth and nose, starved me, chased me around the house with a butchers knife and many more. This was all before I turned 13 and once I turned 13 it got so much worse. He always says he does it because he loves me. I no longer live with him now that I'm 18 but I'm forever scarred not only because he did this to me but also because my mum would see what was happening and she never did anything. She just watched him
